messages:
maya_cs: Morning — quick CS pulse for Acme (tenant X-ACME). Please drop WoW/QoQ token + throughput highlights, latency/error notes, and any onboarding or renewal blockers.


derek_analyst: Pasting the short metrics snapshot for last 7d -> QoQ:
```
WoW tokens: +14%
QoQ tokens: +5%
Peak throughput: 760 rps (Wed 09:18 UTC)
Avg latency: 210ms, p95: 420ms (spike on Wed)
5xx rate: 0.7% (baseline 0.15%)
Estimated spend change WoW: +12% (routed to /generate-heavy)
```

oli_se: saw GPU queue buildup Wed 09:12-09:35 UTC. Autoscale only started scaling at 09:20 due to cold-start thresholds. Created INF-432 to tune burst policy and warm pools.

metrics-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 5xx-error-rate > 0.5% between 2026-03-10 09:10–09:40 UTC. Traces: https://redwood.metrics/acme/trace/af3b2c


tasha_ae: Heads up — renewal risk trending up (~30% at renewal window). Customer cites unpredictable spend and the Wed latency blip. Proposed next step: offer a 3mo dedicated trial to stabilize SLOs. @maya_cs can we get a quick finance estimate?

sam_onboard: Scheduled enablement: Tue 10am PT with Acme engs (invites sent). I'll prep onboarding checklist + prework. Draft checklist: https://docs.google.com/acme-onboard (will share edits).


derek_analyst: quick callout on token vs throughput: many short, repeated requests are inflating token counts while per-request tokens are low. Recommend batching + prefix KV caching. Small eval config I'm proposing:
```
batch_size: 8
prefix_cache: true
max_concurrent: 120
```
Expected outcome: reduce token churn and lower per-token latency during bursts.

oli_se: Adding infra note: temporary mitigation applied — raised burst limit and pre-warmed 2 extra instances for Acme. Will monitor overnight. INF-432 assigned to me.

maya_cs: Action items: 1) INF-432 tuning (oli_se) 2) finance quote for 3mo dedicated trial (maya_cs + tasha_ae) 3) onboarding prework and prompt-eval (sam_onboard) 4) eval plan + batching tests (derek_analyst).
Plan: reconvene same time next week for fresh QoW/QoQ snapshot. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
